overview: This report analyzes GOOGL's 2025Q4 business fundamentals, competitive advantages, and core risks using verified financial data and market insights. All conclusions are backed by evidence IDs from credible sources.
research_topic: 总结GOOGL在2025Q4的业务基本面、优势与核心风险
requirements: 覆盖收入、利润率、现金流、风险、市场表现和近期新闻
所有关键结论必须绑定 evidence_id
输出 Markdown、HTML、JSON、trace 和验证报告

tasks.description: Fetch GOOGL's 2025Q4 financial statements (income statement, cash flow statement) from SEC filings
tasks.expected_output: Financial data with evidence_ids for revenue, net income, operating cash flow

tasks.description: Collect recent news articles (last 30 days) about GOOGL's business developments
tasks.expected_output: News summary with evidence_ids for market events and strategic moves

tasks.description: Analyze revenue drivers and margin trends from financial data
tasks.expected_output: Revenue breakdown and margin analysis with evidence_ids

tasks.description: Evaluate core risks using financial metrics and market news
tasks.expected_output: Risk factors with evidence_ids for operational, market, and regulatory risks

tasks.description: Synthesize business fundamentals and competitive advantages
tasks.expected_output: Competitive advantages with evidence_ids for market position and innovation

tasks.description: Compile comprehensive report with required outputs
tasks.expected_output: Markdown/HTML/JSON report with traceability and citations
Verification report confirming evidence binding compliance
